tools.name: place_cube
tools.title: Place Cube
tools.description: Creates cubes in one reversible edit. Texture and group are optional, allowing untextured blockouts. Explicit face targets never use the current UV selection; partial/custom faces require per-face UV support.

rotation.description: Rotation of the cube.
rotation.markdownDescription: Rotation of the cube.

shade.description: Whether to apply shading to the cube. Java 26.3+ projects ignore this flag; shade=false is mapped to shade_direction_override 'up' there, matching Blockbench's own import.
shade.markdownDescription: Whether to apply shading to the cube. Java 26.3+ projects ignore this flag; shade=false is mapped to shade_direction_override 'up' there, matching Blockbench's own import.

shade_direction_override.description: Java Edition 26.3+ shade direction override: the face direction whose lighting shade is applied to every face. '' removes the override. Replaces the boolean shade flag in formats with java_cube_shade_direction_override (new Java Block projects default to 26.3).
shade_direction_override.markdownDescription: Java Edition 26.3+ shade direction override: the face direction whose lighting shade is applied to every face. '' removes the override. Replaces the boolean shade flag in formats with java_cube_shade_direction_override (new Java Block projects default to 26.3).

light_emission.description: Block light emitted by the cube (0-15). Exported by Java Block formats.
light_emission.markdownDescription: Block light emitted by the cube (0-15). Exported by Java Block formats.

elements.description: Array of cubes to place, with optional Java shading fields.
elements.markdownDescription: Array of cubes to place, with optional Java shading fields.

texture.description: Texture UUID, ID or name. When omitted, uses the default texture if one exists; otherwise creates untextured cubes.
texture.markdownDescription: Texture UUID, ID or name. When omitted, uses the default texture if one exists; otherwise creates untextured cubes.

group.description: Parent group UUID or unique name, or root (default). Missing or ambiguous names are rejected.
group.markdownDescription: Parent group UUID or unique name, or root (default). Missing or ambiguous names are rejected.

anyOf.description: Array of faces to apply the texture to.
anyOf.markdownDescription: Array of faces to apply the texture to.

anyOf.description: true applies texture to all faces with Auto UV; false skips texture assignment and disables Auto UV except in Hytale, which requires Auto UV 1.
anyOf.markdownDescription: true applies texture to all faces with Auto UV; false skips texture assignment and disables Auto UV except in Hytale, which requires Auto UV 1.

face.description: Face to apply the texture to.
face.markdownDescription: Face to apply the texture to.

uv.description: Custom UV rectangle. Hytale requires absolute width/height to match the cube's face dimensions: north/south XY, east/west ZY, up/down XZ.
uv.markdownDescription: Custom UV rectangle. Hytale requires absolute width/height to match the cube's face dimensions: north/south XY, east/west ZY, up/down XZ.

anyOf.description: Array of faces with custom UV mapping.
anyOf.markdownDescription: Array of faces with custom UV mapping.

faces.description: true applies texture to all faces with Auto UV; false skips texture assignment. Named faces use Auto UV; false/custom rectangles disable Auto UV outside Hytale. Hytale always retains Auto UV 1 and custom rectangles must match the geometry's face dimensions. Partial/custom faces require per-face UV support. Single-texture formats may still display the project texture.
faces.markdownDescription: true applies texture to all faces with Auto UV; false skips texture assignment. Named faces use Auto UV; false/custom rectangles disable Auto UV outside Hytale. Hytale always retains Auto UV 1 and custom rectangles must match the geometry's face dimensions. Partial/custom faces require per-face UV support. Single-texture formats may still display the project texture.

tools.name: modify_cube
tools.title: Modify Cube
tools.description: Modifies the cube with the given ID. Auto UV setting: saved as an integer, where 0 means disabled, 1 means enabled, and 2 means relative auto UV (cube position affects UV)

id.description: ID or name of the cube to modify. Defaults to selected, which could be more than one.
id.markdownDescription: ID or name of the cube to modify. Defaults to selected, which could be more than one.

rotation.description: Rotation of the cube.
rotation.markdownDescription: Rotation of the cube.

autouv.description: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.
autouv.markdownDescription: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.

shade.description: Whether to apply shading to the cube. Java 26.3+ projects ignore this flag; shade=false is mapped to shade_direction_override 'up' there, matching Blockbench's own import.
shade.markdownDescription: Whether to apply shading to the cube. Java 26.3+ projects ignore this flag; shade=false is mapped to shade_direction_override 'up' there, matching Blockbench's own import.

shade_direction_override.description: Java Edition 26.3+ shade direction override: the face direction whose lighting shade is applied to every face. '' removes the override. Replaces the boolean shade flag in formats with java_cube_shade_direction_override (new Java Block projects default to 26.3).
shade_direction_override.markdownDescription: Java Edition 26.3+ shade direction override: the face direction whose lighting shade is applied to every face. '' removes the override. Replaces the boolean shade flag in formats with java_cube_shade_direction_override (new Java Block projects default to 26.3).

light_emission.description: Block light emitted by the cube (0-15). Exported by Java Block formats.
light_emission.markdownDescription: Block light emitted by the cube (0-15). Exported by Java Block formats.

color.description: Single digit to represent a color from a palette.
color.markdownDescription: Single digit to represent a color from a palette.

visibility.description: Whether the cube is visible or not.
visibility.markdownDescription: Whether the cube is visible or not.

tools.name: knife_cut_cube
tools.title: Knife Cut Cube
tools.description: Headless Blockbench Knife tool for cubes: splits each target cube with planes perpendicular to one axis at the given positions, keeping each piece's share of the face UVs. The original cube keeps the lowest piece; new pieces get unique names. One undo entry covers every cut and the selection is left unchanged.

cubes.description: Cube UUIDs or unique names to cut. Defaults to the selected cubes.
cubes.markdownDescription: Cube UUIDs or unique names to cut. Defaults to the selected cubes.

axis.description: Axis the cut plane is perpendicular to.
axis.markdownDescription: Axis the cut plane is perpendicular to.

positions.description: Cut-plane coordinates along the axis, in the cube's from/to space (model space for unrotated cubes). Positions closer than the cube's inflate to its from/to edges, or outside it, are skipped for that cube and reported sorted and deduplicated.
positions.markdownDescription: Cut-plane coordinates along the axis, in the cube's from/to space (model space for unrotated cubes). Positions closer than the cube's inflate to its from/to edges, or outside it, are skipped for that cube and reported sorted and deduplicated.

tools.name: slice_cubes_to_block_grid
tools.title: Slice Cubes To Block Grid
tools.description: Cuts cubes wherever they cross a Bedrock block boundary (16-unit grid, x/z centered) and, by default, regroups the pieces into one group per block cell pivoted at that block's origin. Use it to divide an oversized custom block model into per-block sections that each fit Bedrock's 30×30×30 limit. Rotated cubes are left uncut on the affected axes and reported.

cubes.description: Cube UUIDs or unique names to slice. Defaults to every cube in the project.
cubes.markdownDescription: Cube UUIDs or unique names to slice. Defaults to every cube in the project.

axes.description: Axes to slice along. Cubes rotated (or inside groups rotated) about the other two axes are skipped on that axis, as Blockbench's own slicer does.
axes.markdownDescription: Axes to slice along. Cubes rotated (or inside groups rotated) about the other two axes are skipped on that axis, as Blockbench's own slicer does.

cell_size.description: Block size in model units; 16 for Bedrock. Horizontal boundaries sit at ±half a cell, vertical ones at multiples.
cell_size.markdownDescription: Block size in model units; 16 for Bedrock. Horizontal boundaries sit at ±half a cell, vertical ones at multiples.

regroup.description: Move every resulting cube into a group named after its block cell (bottom, top, right_top_front, top2, …) pivoted at that block's origin, so each group is one exportable block section. Pieces leave their previous bone; the report lists each source cube's former group.
regroup.markdownDescription: Move every resulting cube into a group named after its block cell (bottom, top, right_top_front, top2, …) pivoted at that block's origin, so each group is one exportable block section. Pieces leave their previous bone; the report lists each source cube's former group.

parent.description: Parent group UUID or name for the cell groups; must not be rotated. Defaults to the project root.
parent.markdownDescription: Parent group UUID or name for the cell groups; must not be rotated. Defaults to the project root.

group_prefix.description: Prefix for cell group names, e.g. `goal_` yields `goal_top`. Existing groups are reused only when their name and block-origin pivot match; otherwise a numbered name is chosen.
group_prefix.markdownDescription: Prefix for cell group names, e.g. `goal_` yields `goal_top`. Existing groups are reused only when their name and block-origin pivot match; otherwise a numbered name is chosen.

tools.name: inspect_block_bounds
tools.title: Inspect Block Bounds
tools.description: Reports cube, group, and whole-model extents against Blockbench's Bedrock block limit (a 30×30×30 box whose center may sit up to 7 units from the block center), the block cell each cube occupies, and the grid cut positions slice_cubes_to_block_grid would use. Read-only. Extents ignore rotation; rotated cubes are flagged.

cubes.description: Cube UUIDs or unique names to inspect. Defaults to every cube in the project.
cubes.markdownDescription: Cube UUIDs or unique names to inspect. Defaults to every cube in the project.

cell_size.description: Block size in model units; 16 for Bedrock.
cell_size.markdownDescription: Block size in model units; 16 for Bedrock.

max_size.description: Maximum geometry size per axis for one block (Bedrock: 30).
max_size.markdownDescription: Maximum geometry size per axis for one block (Bedrock: 30).

max_center_offset.description: How far the limit box may shift from the block center per axis (Bedrock: 7, giving x/z within ±22 and y within -14…30).
max_center_offset.markdownDescription: How far the limit box may shift from the block center per axis (Bedrock: 7, giving x/z within ±22 and y within -14…30).

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.title: Capture Screenshot
tools.description: Returns the rendered image of a view. Defaults to the user's active viewport ("active"); pass the ID of an offscreen view from create_offscreen_view to render without disturbing the user, or a viewport ID from list_views.

view.description: View to target: "active" for the viewport the user last interacted with, the ID of an offscreen view from create_offscreen_view, or a viewport ID from list_views.
view.markdownDescription: View to target: "active" for the viewport the user last interacted with, the ID of an offscreen view from create_offscreen_view, or a viewport ID from list_views.

tools.name: capture_app_screenshot
tools.title: Capture App Screenshot
tools.description: Returns the image data of the Blockbench app.

tools.name: set_camera_angle
tools.title: Set Camera Angle
tools.description: Moves a view's camera and returns the resulting frame plus the applied camera state. Defaults to the user's active viewport, which changes what they see and clears any side-view lock they had; target an offscreen view from create_offscreen_view to inspect the model from any angle without moving their camera.

view.description: View to target: "active" for the viewport the user last interacted with, the ID of an offscreen view from create_offscreen_view, or a viewport ID from list_views.
view.markdownDescription: View to target: "active" for the viewport the user last interacted with, the ID of an offscreen view from create_offscreen_view, or a viewport ID from list_views.

rotation.description: Camera rotation.
rotation.markdownDescription: Camera rotation.

zoom.description: Orthographic zoom factor (Blockbench default 0.5). Ignored for perspective views and while a side view is locked.
zoom.markdownDescription: Orthographic zoom factor (Blockbench default 0.5). Ignored for perspective views and while a side view is locked.

fov.description: Perspective field of view in degrees. Uses the Blockbench setting when omitted.
fov.markdownDescription: Perspective field of view in degrees. Uses the Blockbench setting when omitted.

locked_angle.description: Lock an orthographic side view (top, bottom, north, south, east, west). Omit to leave the view free.
locked_angle.markdownDescription: Lock an orthographic side view (top, bottom, north, south, east, west). Omit to leave the view free.

tools.name: create_offscreen_view
tools.title: Create Offscreen View
tools.description: Creates a private offscreen viewport that renders the current project without moving the user's camera. Use it with set_camera_angle and capture_screenshot (view: <id>) for multi-angle inspection. The camera starts where the user's is unless copy_view is "none". Up to 4 views may exist at once; delete them with delete_offscreen_view when done.

errorMessage.pattern: Use 1–64 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

id.description: ID for the new view. Generated as view_N when omitted.
id.markdownDescription: ID for the new view. Generated as view_N when omitted.

antialias.description: Multisample antialiasing. Disable for crisp pixel-art inspection.
antialias.markdownDescription: Multisample antialiasing. Disable for crisp pixel-art inspection.

anyOf.description: View to target: "active" for the viewport the user last interacted with, the ID of an offscreen view from create_offscreen_view, or a viewport ID from list_views.
anyOf.markdownDescription: View to target: "active" for the viewport the user last interacted with, the ID of an offscreen view from create_offscreen_view, or a viewport ID from list_views.

copy_view.description: View whose camera seeds the new one. Defaults to "active" (the user's viewport); pass "none" for Blockbench's default angle.
copy_view.markdownDescription: View whose camera seeds the new one. Defaults to "active" (the user's viewport); pass "none" for Blockbench's default angle.

tools.name: list_views
tools.title: List Views
tools.description: Lists render targets: the user's connected viewports (the active one flagged) and the plugin's offscreen views, each with size and camera position, target, projection, FOV, zoom, and side-view lock.

tools.name: resize_offscreen_view
tools.title: Resize Offscreen View
tools.description: Changes the pixel size of an offscreen view. The user's viewports follow their layout and cannot be resized here.

errorMessage.pattern: Use 1–64 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

view.description: ID of the offscreen view to resize.
view.markdownDescription: ID of the offscreen view to resize.

tools.name: delete_offscreen_view
tools.title: Delete Offscreen View
tools.description: Disposes an offscreen view and releases its WebGL context. The user's viewports are not affected.

errorMessage.pattern: Use 1–64 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

view.description: ID of the offscreen view to dispose.
view.markdownDescription: ID of the offscreen view to dispose.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.title: Get Capabilities
tools.description: Discover Blockbench/plugin versions, desktop or web environment, active project summary, and registered model formats. Returns detailed boolean format features (null means unknown; includes molang and java_cube_shade_direction_override) plus the format's remember_files and animation_grouping settings, compact supported-feature lists for all formats, and optional tool registration states. Works with no open project. Format features do not guarantee that every enabled MCP tool can run in the current mode or selection.

format_id.description: Optional registered format ID to inspect, such as 'free'. Defaults to the active project's format. Does not switch or create a project.
format_id.markdownDescription: Optional registered format ID to inspect, such as 'free'. Defaults to the active project's format. Does not switch or create a project.

include_tools.description: Include all registered MCP tool names, stability status, and current enabled state. Use list_modes and set_mode to navigate before calling mode-dependent tools.
include_tools.markdownDescription: Include all registered MCP tool names, stability status, and current enabled state. Use list_modes and set_mode to navigate before calling mode-dependent tools.

tools.name: create_animation
tools.title: Create Animation
tools.description: Creates and selects an undoable animation with linear keyframes for existing bones, using Blockbench editor coordinates. Returns its UUID and actual name.

animation_length.description: Length of the animation in seconds
animation_length.markdownDescription: Length of the animation in seconds

rotation.description: 3D vector [x, y, z].
rotation.markdownDescription: 3D vector [x, y, z].

bones.description: Keyframes keyed by existing bone/group name. Values use Blockbench editor coordinates; rotations are degrees.
bones.markdownDescription: Keyframes keyed by existing bone/group name. Values use Blockbench editor coordinates; rotations are degrees.

additionalProperties.description: Effect name; a particle effect loaded with create_particle_effect is attached so Blockbench previews it
additionalProperties.markdownDescription: Effect name; a particle effect loaded with create_particle_effect is attached so Blockbench previews it

particle_effects.description: Particle effects with timestamps (seconds) as keys, spawned at the entity origin. Use manage_particle_keyframes for locators, scripts and more options.
particle_effects.markdownDescription: Particle effects with timestamps (seconds) as keys, spawned at the entity origin. Use manage_particle_keyframes for locators, scripts and more options.

tools.name: manage_keyframes
tools.title: Manage Keyframes
tools.description: Creates, deletes, or edits keyframes in the animation timeline for specific bones and channels.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.
animation_id.markdownDescription: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

bone_name.description: Name of the bone/group to manage keyframes for.
bone_name.markdownDescription: Name of the bone/group to manage keyframes for.

time.description: Time in seconds for the keyframe.
time.markdownDescription: Time in seconds for the keyframe.

values.description: Values: [x,y,z] for position/rotation, number for uniform scale.
values.markdownDescription: Values: [x,y,z] for position/rotation, number for uniform scale.

bezier_handles.description: Bezier handle positions for bezier interpolation.
bezier_handles.markdownDescription: Bezier handle positions for bezier interpolation.

tools.name: animation_graph_editor
tools.title: Animation Graph Editor
tools.description: Edits a bone channel's interpolation or numeric Bezier easing in one reversible edit. Uses native per-axis handle arrays and chronological segment durations. Custom points are normalized time/value fractions. Partial-axis edits require existing Bezier keys; key-wide mode changes require all axes. Rejects curve edits ignored by quaternion rotation. Inspect neighboring segments after range edits.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.
animation_id.markdownDescription: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

bone_name.description: Name of the bone/group to modify curves for.
bone_name.markdownDescription: Name of the bone/group to modify curves for.

axis.description: Axes to edit. Linear, stepped and smooth require all because interpolation is key-wide. Partial-axis easing/custom edits require selected keys already using Bezier interpolation, preserving other axes' handles.
axis.markdownDescription: Axes to edit. Linear, stepped and smooth require all because interpolation is key-wide. Partial-axis easing/custom edits require selected keys already using Bezier interpolation, preserving other axes' handles.

action.description: Curve modification. Easing/custom require at least two distinct chronological numeric single-data-point keys. Smooth and Bezier rotation edits are unavailable when native quaternion interpolation would ignore them.
action.markdownDescription: Curve modification. Easing/custom require at least two distinct chronological numeric single-data-point keys. Smooth and Bezier rotation edits are unavailable when native quaternion interpolation would ignore them.

keyframe_range.description: Finite ordered time range selecting existing keys; omitted means the full channel. Key-wide interpolation can affect neighboring segments at range boundaries, so edit the full channel when boundary continuity matters.
keyframe_range.markdownDescription: Finite ordered time range selecting existing keys; omitted means the full channel. Key-wide interpolation can affect neighboring segments at range boundaries, so edit the full channel when boundary continuity matters.

control_point_1.description: Outgoing normalized control point [time fraction in 0..1, value fraction] for each selected adjacent-key segment. Finite value fractions outside 0..1 allow overshoot.
control_point_1.markdownDescription: Outgoing normalized control point [time fraction in 0..1, value fraction] for each selected adjacent-key segment. Finite value fractions outside 0..1 allow overshoot.

control_point_2.description: Incoming normalized control point [time fraction in 0..1, value fraction], measured from the segment start. Converted to native per-axis offsets relative to the ending key.
control_point_2.markdownDescription: Incoming normalized control point [time fraction in 0..1, value fraction], measured from the segment start. Converted to native per-axis offsets relative to the ending key.

custom_curve.description: Normalized cubic Bezier control points, required for custom action. Conversion uses each segment's duration and edited-axis endpoint values; unrelated axis handles are preserved.
custom_curve.markdownDescription: Normalized cubic Bezier control points, required for custom action. Conversion uses each segment's duration and edited-axis endpoint values; unrelated axis handles are preserved.

tools.name: bone_rigging
tools.title: Bone Rigging
tools.description: Creates and manipulates the bone structure (rig) of a model for animation. The set_ik action is deprecated; use set_ik_controller for Blockbench's null-object IK (source, target, pole).

action.description: Action to perform on the bone structure.
action.markdownDescription: Action to perform on the bone structure.

parent.description: Parent bone name; create also accepts a group UUID or root.
parent.markdownDescription: Parent bone name; create also accepts a group UUID or root.

rotation.description: Initial rotation of the bone.
rotation.markdownDescription: Initial rotation of the bone.

children.description: Names or UUIDs of existing elements/groups to add when creating a bone. For rename, the first entry is the new name.
children.markdownDescription: Names or UUIDs of existing elements/groups to add when creating a bone. For rename, the first entry is the new name.

ik_enabled.description: Deprecated; prefer set_ik_controller. true makes this bone the end effector of a null-object IK controller (created as <bone>_ik when ik_target is omitted); false clears ik_target on controllers driving it.
ik_enabled.markdownDescription: Deprecated; prefer set_ik_controller. true makes this bone the end effector of a null-object IK controller (created as <bone>_ik when ik_target is omitted); false clears ik_target on controllers driving it.

ik_target.description: Name or UUID of the null object that drives this bone as the IK controller.
ik_target.markdownDescription: Name or UUID of the null object that drives this bone as the IK controller.

mirror_axis.description: Axis to mirror the bone across.
mirror_axis.markdownDescription: Axis to mirror the bone across.

tools.name: animation_timeline
tools.title: Animation Timeline
tools.description: Controls the animation timeline: playback, time scrubbing, length, FPS, loop mode, and keyframe selection by time range or relative to the playhead (select_before_playhead/select_after_playhead return the selected keyframe UUIDs).

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.
animation_id.markdownDescription: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

action.description: Timeline action to perform. select_before_playhead/select_after_playhead replace the keyframe selection with bone keyframes at or before/after the playhead (1e-5 s tolerance, like Blockbench 5.2's native actions) and return their UUIDs.
action.markdownDescription: Timeline action to perform. select_before_playhead/select_after_playhead replace the keyframe selection with bone keyframes at or before/after the playhead (1e-5 s tolerance, like Blockbench 5.2's native actions) and return their UUIDs.

time.description: Time in seconds. Required for set_time; for select_before_playhead/select_after_playhead it is the reference time and defaults to the current playhead.
time.markdownDescription: Time in seconds. Required for set_time; for select_before_playhead/select_after_playhead it is the reference time and defaults to the current playhead.

length.description: Animation length in seconds, including all keyframes (for set_length action).
length.markdownDescription: Animation length in seconds, including all keyframes (for set_length action).

fps.description: Integer frames per second, 10–120 (for set_fps action; Blockbench minimum is 10).
fps.markdownDescription: Integer frames per second, 10–120 (for set_fps action; Blockbench minimum is 10).

scope.description: Keyframes considered by select_before_playhead/select_after_playhead. animation: every bone animator of the target animation, including ones hidden from the timeline. timeline: only animators shown in the timeline with visible channels, matching the native action; requires the target animation to be selected.
scope.markdownDescription: Keyframes considered by select_before_playhead/select_after_playhead. animation: every bone animator of the target animation, including ones hidden from the timeline. timeline: only animators shown in the timeline with visible channels, matching the native action; requires the target animation to be selected.

tools.name: batch_keyframe_operations
tools.title: Batch Keyframe Operations
tools.description: Edits keyframes in the active animation atomically; all includes hidden animators. Numeric value edits use native transform values. Bake samples continuous numeric curves within selected channel spans, caps output at 10000 samples, and restores the playhead. Expressions, step/pre-post curves and effect channels require native baking.

selection.description: Which active-animation keyframes to operate on. all includes hidden or collapsed animators.
selection.markdownDescription: Which active-animation keyframes to operate on. all includes hidden or collapsed animators.

offset_time.description: Time offset to apply; resulting keyframes must remain between 0 and 10000 seconds.
offset_time.markdownDescription: Time offset to apply; resulting keyframes must remain between 0 and 10000 seconds.

offset_values.description: Numeric [x,y,z] value offset. Requires transform keyframes with a single numeric data point; expressions and pre/post values require native tools.
offset_values.markdownDescription: Numeric [x,y,z] value offset. Requires transform keyframes with a single numeric data point; expressions and pre/post values require native tools.

scale_factor.description: Scale factor for keyframe times around scale_pivot. Does not scale values; zero is accepted only when it creates no timestamp collisions.
scale_factor.markdownDescription: Scale factor for keyframe times around scale_pivot. Does not scale values; zero is accepted only when it creates no timestamp collisions.

mirror_axis.description: Numeric component to negate. Requires transform keyframes with a single numeric data point.
mirror_axis.markdownDescription: Numeric component to negate. Requires transform keyframes with a single numeric data point.

bake_interval.description: Sampling interval in seconds (minimum 0.001; at most 10000 samples). Bakes only selected transform channels between their selected times. Requires continuous numeric single-data-point keyframes; expressions, effects and stepped/pre-post curves require native baking.
bake_interval.markdownDescription: Sampling interval in seconds (minimum 0.001; at most 10000 samples). Bakes only selected transform channels between their selected times. Requires continuous numeric single-data-point keyframes; expressions, effects and stepped/pre-post curves require native baking.

tools.name: animation_copy_paste
tools.title: Animation Copy/Paste
tools.description: Copies native keyframe data points and curve metadata into a plugin-local clipboard. Paste preserves exact timestamps, replaces same-channel/time collisions and is undoable, including newly created animators. Mirror paste uses native position/rotation/curve mirroring; scale is unchanged.

time_range.description: Time range to copy. If not provided, copies all keyframes.
time_range.markdownDescription: Time range to copy. If not provided, copies all keyframes.

time_offset.description: Offset for exact, unsnapped pasted timestamps; results must remain between 0 and 10000 seconds. Existing keys at the same channel/time are replaced.
time_offset.markdownDescription: Offset for exact, unsnapped pasted timestamps; results must remain between 0 and 10000 seconds. Existing keys at the same channel/time are replaced.

mirror_axis.description: Native mirror axis for mirror_paste (default x). Position negates this axis, rotation negates the other two axes, scale is unchanged; curve handles follow native mirroring.
mirror_axis.markdownDescription: Native mirror axis for mirror_paste (default x). Position negates this axis, rotation negates the other two axes, scale is unchanged; curve handles follow native mirroring.

tools.name: variable_placeholders
tools.title: Variable Placeholders
tools.description: Reads or edits the project's animation Variable Placeholders text (one `variable = expression` per line), used to preview Molang animations. add writes a value, slider('name', step, min, max), toggle('name') or impulse('name', duration) line like the native Create Variable Placeholder dialog; set replaces all text; remove deletes a variable's lines. Changes sync through the native panel, refresh the animation preview and return the parsed lines and live controls. Placeholder edits are not recorded in Undo. Requires a format with Molang enabled.

action.description: get: read text, parsed lines and live controls. set: replace the whole text. add: write one structured line. remove: delete every line assigning variable.
action.markdownDescription: get: read text, parsed lines and live controls. set: replace the whole text. add: write one structured line. remove: delete every line assigning variable.

text.description: Complete placeholder text for set; one `variable = expression` per line. Empty clears all placeholders.
text.markdownDescription: Complete placeholder text for set; one `variable = expression` per line. Empty clears all placeholders.

errorMessage.pattern: Use a Molang variable name such as variable.speed or v.speed.

variable.description: Variable assigned by the line, e.g. variable.speed (v./q./t./c. short prefixes are expanded by Blockbench).
variable.markdownDescription: Variable assigned by the line, e.g. variable.speed (v./q./t./c. short prefixes are expanded by Blockbench).

errorMessage.pattern: Expressions must be a single line.

value.description: Constant number or single-line Molang expression.
value.markdownDescription: Constant number or single-line Molang expression.

errorMessage.pattern: Use a Molang variable name such as variable.speed or v.speed.

variable.description: Variable assigned by the line, e.g. variable.speed (v./q./t./c. short prefixes are expanded by Blockbench).
variable.markdownDescription: Variable assigned by the line, e.g. variable.speed (v./q./t./c. short prefixes are expanded by Blockbench).

tools.name: set_ik_controller
tools.title: Set IK Controller
tools.description: Creates or updates an inverse-kinematics controller. Blockbench drives IK from a null object: ik_target is the end effector (group/bone, armature bone, or locator) that reaches for the null object, ik_source is the chain root (defaults to the null object's parent), ik_pole (Blockbench 5.2+) sets the bend direction, and lock_ik_target_rotation keeps the effector's rotation. Works with bone rigs and armatures (5.2 allows null objects under armatures and armature bones). Validates every reference and that the target lies below the chain root; returns the solved chain. Replaces the deprecated bone_rigging set_ik flags, which Blockbench never read.

position.markdownDescription: Null object position [x, y, z] as Blockbench stores it (model space for root and group parents). Defaults to the end effector's world pivot when creating.

parent.description: Parent group, armature, or armature bone (UUID or name), or 'root'. Defaults to root when creating. When ik_source is empty the parent is the implicit chain root, so keep IK controllers outside the chain they drive.
parent.markdownDescription: Parent group, armature, or armature bone (UUID or name), or 'root'. Defaults to root when creating. When ik_source is empty the parent is the implicit chain root, so keep IK controllers outside the chain they drive.

tools.name: get_mesh_info
tools.title: Get Mesh Info
tools.description: Inspects a mesh by UUID/name or the first selected mesh without changing geometry, selection, or undo history. Returns transforms, parent, total counts, mesh-local bounds, selection counts, and optional paginated vertices/faces with actual runtime keys. Faces use perimeter vertex order and normalized mesh-local normals (zero for degenerate faces), stored texture references, and optional UVs. Texture status distinguishes resolved, missing, unassigned (false), disabled (null), and unset; default format materials are not resolved. Pages sort keys lexicographically and expose next_offset; geometry must remain unchanged between calls. Set include_vertices/include_faces false for a compact summary.

mesh_id.description: Mesh UUID or name. Omit to inspect the first selected mesh.
mesh_id.markdownDescription: Mesh UUID or name. Omit to inspect the first selected mesh.

include_vertices.description: Include a page of vertex keys, local positions, and selection flags.
include_vertices.markdownDescription: Include a page of vertex keys, local positions, and selection flags.

include_faces.markdownDescription: Include a page of face keys, perimeter vertices, local normals, texture references, and selection flags.

include_uv.markdownDescription: Include per-vertex UV coordinates for returned faces, in Blockbench texture units.

face_offset.description: Zero-based offset into lexicographically sorted face keys.
face_offset.markdownDescription: Zero-based offset into lexicographically sorted face keys.

tools.description: Creates a new PBR material (texture group with is_material=true) and optionally assigns textures to PBR channels. texture.description: Texture name or UUID to assign.
texture.markdownDescription: Texture name or UUID to assign.

channel.markdownDescription: PBR channel to assign the texture to.

tools.title: Set GeckoLib Project Settings
tools.description: Sets the GeckoLib mod ID, model type and object ID on the active project. Values are validated against the plugin's namespace rules before anything is written. Does not generate the armor template rig.

tools.title: List GeckoLib Easings
tools.description: Lists every easing name GeckoLib accepts on keyframes, which of them read easingArgs, and each argument's default and meaning. Needs no project, so it can be called while planning an animation.

tools.title: Get GeckoLib Keyframe Easing
tools.description: Reads the GeckoLib easing, easing arguments and interpolation of keyframes on one bone channel, or of the current timeline selection. An easing governs the segment arriving at its keyframe, so the first keyframe of a channel is reported as inert.

animation_id.markdownDescription: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

times.description: Keyframe times in seconds. Requires bone_name; omit to target every keyframe of that channel.
times.markdownDescription: Keyframe times in seconds. Requires bone_name; omit to target every keyframe of that channel.

tools.description: Writes a GeckoLib easing (and its arguments) onto keyframes on one bone channel, or onto the current timeline selection, as one undoable edit. GeckoLib easings apply only to linear keyframes and shape the segment arriving at the keyframe they are set on, so the first keyframe of each channel is skipped and reported. animation_id.markdownDescription: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

tools.name: hytale_validate_model
tools.title: Validate Hytale Model
tools.description: Checks exported main-model node count using the installed Hytale codec and verifies bitmap dimensions are multiples of 32. Does not validate attachment exports, shading, all UVs, animation integration or target-engine rendering.

tools.name: hytale_set_cube_properties
tools.title: Set Hytale Cube Properties
tools.description: Sets Hytale-specific properties on a cube: shading_mode (flat, standard, fullbright, reflective) and double_sided.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses selected cube.
cube_id.markdownDescription: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses selected cube.

shading_mode.description: Shading mode: flat (no lighting), standard (normal), fullbright (emissive), reflective
shading_mode.markdownDescription: Shading mode: flat (no lighting), standard (normal), fullbright (emissive), reflective

double_sided.description: Whether to render both sides of faces
double_sided.markdownDescription: Whether to render both sides of faces

tools.name: hytale_get_cube_properties
tools.title: Get Hytale Cube Properties
tools.description: Gets Hytale-specific properties from a cube (shading_mode, double_sided).

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses selected cube.
cube_id.markdownDescription: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses selected cube.

tools.name: hytale_create_quad
tools.title: Create Hytale Quad
tools.description: Creates a Hytale quad with exactly one enabled face matching the signed normal direction, per-face UV and Auto UV 1. Positive width/height and parent references are validated before one reversible edit.

position.description: Finite position [x, y, z] of the quad's starting corner.
position.markdownDescription: Finite position [x, y, z] of the quad's starting corner.

size.description: Positive finite [width, height]. Width/height axes are Z/Y for X normals, X/Z for Y normals, and X/Y for Z normals.
size.markdownDescription: Positive finite [width, height]. Width/height axes are Z/Y for X normals, X/Z for Y normals, and X/Y for Z normals.

group.description: Parent group UUID or unique name, or root (default). Missing or ambiguous names are rejected.
group.markdownDescription: Parent group UUID or unique name, or root (default). Missing or ambiguous names are rejected.

tools.name: hytale_list_attachments
tools.title: List Hytale Attachments
tools.description: Lists all attachment collections in the current Hytale project.

tools.name: hytale_set_attachment_piece
tools.title: Set Attachment Piece
tools.description: Marks or unmarks a group as an attachment piece. Attachment pieces attach to like-named bones in the main model.

group_name.description: Name of the group to mark as attachment piece
group_name.markdownDescription: Name of the group to mark as attachment piece

is_piece.description: Whether the group is an attachment piece
is_piece.markdownDescription: Whether the group is an attachment piece

tools.name: hytale_list_attachment_pieces
tools.title: List Attachment Pieces
tools.description: Lists all groups marked as attachment pieces.

tools.name: hytale_create_visibility_keyframe
tools.title: Create Visibility Keyframe
tools.description: Creates a visibility keyframe for a bone. Hytale supports toggling node visibility at keyframes.

time.description: Finite time in seconds between 0 and 10000 for the visibility keyframe.
time.markdownDescription: Finite time in seconds between 0 and 10000 for the visibility keyframe.

visible.description: Whether the bone is visible at this keyframe
visible.markdownDescription: Whether the bone is visible at this keyframe

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.
animation_id.markdownDescription: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

tools.name: hytale_set_animation_loop
tools.title: Set Animation Loop Mode
tools.description: Sets the loop mode for a Hytale animation. Hytale supports "loop" (continuous) or "hold" (freeze on last frame).

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.
animation_id.markdownDescription: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

loop_mode.description: Loop mode: loop (continuous), hold (freeze on last frame), once (play once)
loop_mode.markdownDescription: Loop mode: loop (continuous), hold (freeze on last frame), once (play once)

tools.name: hytale_set_cube_stretch
tools.title: Set Cube Stretch
tools.description: Sets the stretch values for a cube. Hytale uses stretch instead of float sizes for better UV handling.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses selected cube.
cube_id.markdownDescription: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses selected cube.

tools.name: hytale_get_cube_stretch
tools.title: Get Cube Stretch
tools.description: Gets the stretch values for a cube.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses selected cube.
cube_id.markdownDescription: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses selected cube.

resources.name: project-files
resources.title: Blockbench Project Files
resources.description: Returns the active project's live .bbmodel file with unsaved edits and embedded textures. UUID-based URIs remain stable across renames. Select a project before reading its file; reading never switches tabs or saves to disk.

resources.name: projects
resources.title: Blockbench Projects
resources.description: Returns information about available projects. List URIs use the slugified project name (e.g. `projects://my-character`) when unique, or `projects://<slug>~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: nodes
resources.title: Blockbench Nodes
resources.description: Returns the current 3D nodes in the editor. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `nodes://head`) when unique, with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: textures
resources.title: Blockbench Textures
resources.description: Returns information about textures. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `textures://skin`) when unique, with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, slug, or short numeric texture id.

resources.name: reference_models
resources.title: Reference Models
resources.description: Returns reference models in the current project. Requires the Reference Models plugin. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `reference-models://turntable`) with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: validator-status
resources.title: Validator Status
resources.description: Returns the current validation status including error/warning counts and a summary of all problems.

resources.name: validator-checks
resources.title: Validator Checks
resources.description: Returns information about registered validator checks. Use without an ID to list all checks, or provide a check ID to get details about a specific check.

resources.name: validator-warnings
resources.title: Validator Warnings
resources.description: Returns all current validation warnings with element references where available.

resources.name: validator-errors
resources.title: Validator Errors
resources.description: Returns all current validation errors with element references where available.

resources.name: hytale-format
resources.title: Hytale Format Information
resources.description: Returns comprehensive information about the current Hytale format, including format type, block size, node limits, and feature support.

resources.name: hytale-attachments
resources.title: Hytale Attachments
resources.description: Returns information about attachment collections. List URIs use slugified collection names (e.g. `hytale://attachments/helmet`) with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: hytale-pieces
resources.title: Hytale Attachment Pieces
resources.description: Returns groups marked as attachment pieces — they connect to like-named bones in the main model. List URIs use slugified bone names (e.g. `hytale://pieces/hand-right`) with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision.

resources.name: hytale-cubes
resources.title: Hytale Cubes
resources.description: Returns cubes with Hytale-specific properties (shading_mode, double_sided, stretch). List URIs use slugified cube names (e.g. `hytale://cubes/torso`) with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision.
